tagline: 奥林巴斯数码单反相机，1986 年发布
description: 奥林巴斯于1986年推出的数码单反相机。快门速度Electronically controlled vertical travel focal-plane shutter. Shutter speed: 2–1/2000 sec。

specs.快门: Electronically controlled vertical travel focal-plane shutter. Shutter speed: 2–1/2000 sec
specs.卡口: Olympus OM for AF lenses (accepts OM manual and OM-AF lenses)
specs.闪光灯: Full synchro with F280; TTL 'flashmatic' sync up to 1/100 with PowerGrip 300; TTL direct 'OTF' with T-series flashes.

specs.英文简介: The Olympus OM-707 was released by Olympus as part of its successful OM system in 1986, and was their first attempt to make a fully autofocus SLR body.
